## Time functions

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [t_funcs.square](t_funcs.square.qmd#maxwellbloch.t_funcs.square) | Return a square (top-hat) pulse time function. |
| [t_funcs.gaussian](t_funcs.gaussian.qmd#maxwellbloch.t_funcs.gaussian) | Return a Gaussian pulse time function. |
| [t_funcs.sech](t_funcs.sech.qmd#maxwellbloch.t_funcs.sech) | Return a sech pulse time function. |
| [t_funcs.ramp_on](t_funcs.ramp_on.qmd#maxwellbloch.t_funcs.ramp_on) | Return a ramp-on time function. |
| [t_funcs.ramp_off](t_funcs.ramp_off.qmd#maxwellbloch.t_funcs.ramp_off) | Return a ramp-off time function. |
| [t_funcs.ramp_onoff](t_funcs.ramp_onoff.qmd#maxwellbloch.t_funcs.ramp_onoff) | Return a ramp-on / ramp-off time function. |
| [t_funcs.ramp_offon](t_funcs.ramp_offon.qmd#maxwellbloch.t_funcs.ramp_offon) | Return a ramp-off / ramp-on time function. |
| [t_funcs.sinc](t_funcs.sinc.qmd#maxwellbloch.t_funcs.sinc) | Return a sinc pulse time function. |
| [t_funcs.intp](t_funcs.intp.qmd#maxwellbloch.t_funcs.intp) | Return an interpolated time function. |

| | |
| --- | --- |
